simple.meaning: חוּט (chûwṭ) is a Hebrew concept word meaning “a string ; by implication, a measuring tape.” BibleIQ follows how Scripture develops this idea across its occurrences.
simple.biblicalBackground: The concept appears 7 times across Genesis, Joshua, Judges, 1 Kings, Ecclesiastes, and 2 more, beginning at Genesis 14:23. Its contexts include family, family line, land.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to חוּט (H2339).
simple.whyItMatters: Concept words shape biblical themes. BibleIQ keeps the concept grounded in actual verse evidence instead of starting with a later theological definition.

timeline.evidenceText: that I will not take a thread nor a sandal strap nor anything that is yours, lest you should say, ‘I have made Abram rich.’

Behold, when we come into the land, tie this line of scarlet thread in the window which you used to let us down. Gather to yourself into the house your father, your mother, your brothers, and all your father’s household.
So Delilah took new ropes and bound him with them, then said to him, “The Philistines are on you, Samson!” The ambush was waiting in the inner room. He broke them off his arms like a thread.
For he fashioned the two pillars of bronze, eighteen cubits high apiece; and a line of twelve cubits encircled either of them.
If a man prevails against one who is alone, two shall withstand him; and a threefold cord is not quickly broken.

As for the pillars, the height of the one pillar was eighteen cubits;* A cubit is the length from the tip of the middle finger to the elbow on a man’s arm, or about 18 inches or 46 centimeters. and a line of twelve cubits encircled it; and its thickness was four fingers. It was hollow.

definitions.short: a string ; by implication, a measuring tape
definitions.full: H2339. chut חוּט noun masculine Josh 2:18 thread, cord, line (Late Hebrew id. ; Arabic , Aramaic , חוּטָא ) — ׳ח absolute Gen 14:23 2 t.; construct Josh 2:18 + 3t.; — 1 thread , as easily broken Judg 16:12 (simile); as composing a rope or cord; ח ׳תִּקְוַת הַזֶּה הַשָּׁנִי Josh 2:18 (JE) this cord of scarlet thread (literally the cord of this thread of scarlet); probably also נַעַל שְׂרוֺךְ וְעַד מִחוּט Gen 14:23 from a thread to a sandal-thong ; in simile הַשָּׁנִי ׳כְּח Song 4:3 like a thread of scarlet are thy lips. 2 cord , ׳הַח הַמְּשֻׁלָּשׁ Eccl 4:12 a three-fold cord. 3 line , as measure of length 1Kin 7:15 and a line of twelve cubits surrounded (i.e. would surround) it (compare קָו 7:23 ), so Jer 52:21 . חִוִּי see below II. חוה .
definitions.rootNote: from an unused root probably meaning to sew;
